approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: An endearing cartoon of a little orange robot doing an ordinary chore: watering one potted green plant with a small watering can. Widescreen composition, robot and plant fully visible, charming simple rounded cartoon shapes, soft pastel background and warm gentle light. One continuous steady shot for all 8 seconds. The little orange robot gently tilts the watering can, a gentle stream of water falls into the pot, and the robot carefully finishes watering. Keep the robot design and plant consistent. Throughout the entire video, from the very first frame to the last frame, display the exact words 'Small steps' at the top center in clear, large, readable lettering, safely inside the frame. The title stays fixed and unchanged throughout. No other words. Silent video, no music, speech or sound effects.
